purpose: Candidate lineage roles for the YOLO+Mamba detector chain. A row here is a CLAIM to be checked, not a fact: the inventory tool resolves each path, hashes it, reads what the artifact says about itself, and derives parent edges from the artifact's own recorded args. `expected_init_parent` / `expected_teacher` are the protocol's story and are reported as ok / mismatch / unverifiable against what the bytes say. Missing files stay listed and are marked unavailable; nothing is substituted.

s.pretrained_yolo.note: External pretrained YOLO26s with the original Detect head (hashed as a blob; not unpickled).

s.legacy_teacher.note: Historical gated teacher (trained to epoch 12). Parent of the legacy v14 line and source of the production s backbone engine ONNX.

s.legacy_cache.note: Historical TRT feature cache used by the legacy GT runs and the controlled refit.

s.legacy_parent_gt.note: Legacy GT fine-tune parent of v14 (N=1-era runtime).

s.legacy_v14.note: Previous production checkpoint (epochs 1-30 warm-start + 31-60 resume; see report_data/mamba_v14_training_audit.md). The stored args are the RESUME invocation, so the recorded mamba_ckpt points at itself.

s.controlled_refit.note: Controlled frozen-SSM N=16 refit of the legacy parent (single-edge replay).

s.adapted_teacher.note: Domain-adapted gated teacher, protocol-fixed at epoch 12 (run continued to epoch 19; best.ckpt is NOT the protocol teacher).

s.teacher_cache.note: Immutable 7-sequence teacher feature cache consumed by distill and GT2.

s.distill.note: Mamba head distillation end (frozen SSM, cached teacher features).

s.gt1.note: GT1: live teacher, gt_ratio 0.5. Shared warm-start of every matched T3->T1 / implicit pair.

s.gt2_plain.note: Plain GT2 (cache, gt_ratio 0) = v14replica final; superseded as production by T3->T1.

s.t3t1_phase_a.note: T3->T1 Phase A: --add-temporal clip_len 3 (temporal blocks first appear here).

s.t3t1_phase_b.note: T3->T1 Phase B: clip_len 1 spatial re-adaptation. Production s checkpoint per configs/presets/mamba_whole_graph.yaml.

s.implicit_s42.note: Matched implicit all-frames T=4 control for T3->T1 (same GT1 warm start, same seed 42).

s.t3t1_phase_a_shared_s43.note: Phase A of the shared-GT1 seed-43 pair.

s.t3t1_shared_s43.note: Explicit T3->T1 at seed 43 from the shared GT1 (matched to s.implicit_s43).

s.t3t1_phase_a_shared_s44.note: Phase A of the shared-GT1 seed-44 pair.

s.t3t1_shared_s44.note: Explicit T3->T1 at seed 44 from the shared GT1 (matched to s.implicit_s44).

s.distill_s13.note: Seed-20260613 reseed of the student chain (teacher/cache fixed).

s.gt1_s13.note: Seed-specific GT1 (the GT1-start confound of the old paired T3->T1 comparison).

s.t3t1_s13.note: Old seed-specific-GT1 T3->T1 pair member; compare with s.gt2_plain_s{seed} only (not with the shared-GT1 implicit controls).

s.distill_s14.note: Seed-20260614 reseed of the student chain (teacher/cache fixed).

s.gt1_s14.note: Seed-specific GT1 (the GT1-start confound of the old paired T3->T1 comparison).

s.t3t1_s14.note: Old seed-specific-GT1 T3->T1 pair member; compare with s.gt2_plain_s{seed} only (not with the shared-GT1 implicit controls).

s.deployment_preset.note: Headline s preset. Deployment identity = the artifacts this file names.

s.backbone_engine.note: FPN backbone TRT engine named by the s preset. Engine bytes are not attributable; the associated ONNX (same stem, this file's claim) is matched against teacher checkpoints by BN-folded conv weights and biases.

s.backbone_engine_v14replica_e12.note: Backbone engine exported from the v14replica teacher; NOT referenced by any preset.

s.cpp_head_script.note: Default C++ Mamba head TorchScript (DEFAULT_CPP_MAMBA_HEAD_SCRIPT). Source checkpoint not recorded anywhere machine-readable.

m.adapted_teacher.note: m gated teacher, protocol-fixed at epoch 12 (best.ckpt is not the protocol teacher).

m.teacher_cache.note: Cache the m distill/GT2 checkpoints record as their cache_dir.

m.teacher_cache_gpu_decode.note: GPU-decode rebuild of the m cache (different decode backend => different bytes; a separate node, not a substitute).

m.t3t1_phase_b_gpu_decode.note: GPU-decode training-chain variant; not the preset checkpoint.

m.backbone_engine.note: Preset comment says exported from the m teacher ckpt. The ONNX associated here has a different stem (`yolo26m_backbone_640` vs `_best`); the association is this file's claim, checked only at the ONNX-initializer level.

m.head_engine.note: Mamba head TRT engine named by the m preset.
